description: Old newspaper clipping (Coconut Bars) taped to a recipe card, photographed in front of a recipe box. Two parts: a crust, then a topping after 'Then:'. Nuts (1 cup) and coconut (1 cup, spelled 'cocoanut') appear only in the method, so a complete draft lists them too (11 ingredients). 325°F; 20 then about 25 minutes; makes about 2 dozen bars. (The photo was cropped to remove the submitter's name, address, and phone number.)
